title: Richest Customer Wealth
description:
You are given a matrix accounts of size m × n.

Each row represents a customer
Each value represents money in a bank account
Task

Find the maximum total money any customer has.

How to Calculate
For each row → sum all values
Return the maximum sum
Examples

Example 1

[[1,2,3],[3,2,1]]
→ 6

Example 2

[[1,5],[7,3],[3,5]]
→ 10

Example 3

[[2,8,7],[7,1,3],[1,9,5]]
→ 17
Constraints
1 ≤ m, n ≤ 50
1 ≤ accounts[i][j] ≤ 100
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
